issues.summary: Customs selected container OCLU3488652 (40HC) under HBL MFCIM260011 / MBL OCLU260407 (infusion pumps, HS 9018.90) for physical inspection; it passed and the shipment was released on 2026-03-24.
Customs queried the import licence number declared for the medical devices under HBL MFCIM260011 and required a copy of the licence from the consignee before completing the inspection.

decisions.summary: Jiwoo Han will attend the physical inspection of container OCLU3488652 together with Sunwoo Choi on behalf of Meridian Freight.
Insoo Hwang is to send the import licence copy directly to customs to resolve the licence number query for HBL MFCIM260011.

tasks.summary: Jiwoo Han to attend the physical inspection of container OCLU3488652 with Sunwoo Choi; attendance confirmed and inspection passed.
